snippet.title: Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey Alpha V1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Play it here!: https://mr-qwil.itch.io/trunkeys-amazing-odyssey

Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey Alpha V1 is OUT NOW!
Collect shiny objects of all shapes and sizes as you guide Trunkey through explorative levels, aiming to steal as much as possible before night falls! Just be sure to stay on the lookout for hostile wildlife...
